prose.purpose: Note bodies, memos, the mandate — the page register.

shadows.name: xs
shadows.purpose: Triggers and inputs — the only resting shadow, barely there.

shadows.name: md
shadows.purpose: Menus and popovers — lifted by user action.

motion.name: ease-out-quart
motion.purpose: The only easing. Exponential ease-out; no bounce.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one saturated fill on any surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: oklch(0.55 0.14 155); color: #fff; height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; font: 500 14px 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.5 0.14 155); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.55 0.14 155); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: #fff; color: oklch(0.24 0.012 155); height: 32px; padding: 6px 12px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.92 0.005 155); border-radius: 6px; font: 500 13px 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: oklch(0.955 0.006 155); } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.55 0.14 155); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Input
components.description: Transparent field, border sharpens on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 36px; width: 100%; padding: 4px 12px; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.24 0.012 155); border: 1px solid oklch(0.885 0.006 155); border-radius: 6px; font: 400 14px 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.49 0.016 155); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.55 0.14 155); outline-offset: 1px; border-color: oklch(0.55 0.14 155); }

components.name: Option Badge
components.description: Data color: pale tint + same-hue ink (emerald shown).
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; background: oklch(0.955 0.04 155); color: oklch(0.45 0.113 155); font: 500 12px 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Nav Item (active)
components.description: Sidebar row in the selection wash.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 6px; color: oklch(0.49 0.016 155); font: 500 13px 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-nav:hover { background: oklch(0.945 0.005 155); color: oklch(0.24 0.012 155); } .ds-nav-active { background: oklch(0.962 0.022 155); color: oklch(0.24 0.012 155); } .ds-nav:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.55 0.14 155); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Tooltip
components.css: .ds-tooltip { display: inline-block; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 6px; background: oklch(0.24 0.012 155); color: #fff; font: 400 12px 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: A serious instrument for someone who reads for a living: a clean desk, good light, a ledger on one side and a well-set book on the other. The interface is precise, calm, and fast — density done the Attio way, speed felt the Linear way, and character carried entirely by one deep pine-green accent and the typography, never by the surface. The tool disappears; the research remains.
keyCharacteristics: Pure white ground; color appears only where it carries meaning
Two registers, one system: ledger for data, page for prose
Keyboard-first; latency is a design defect
Dense tables that stay calm — whitespace spent deliberately, not scattered
WCAG AA is a floor, not a target: body text >=4.5:1, always

rules.name: The Two-Tier Rule
rules.body: The primary is the only fully saturated fill on a surface; option badges are always a pale tint with same-hue ink.

rules.name: The Meaning Rule
rules.body: Color only ever encodes information: action, selection, state, stage, status. If a color choice can't name what it encodes, it is forbidden.

rules.name: The Focus Rule
rules.body: One treatment everywhere: a 2px outline at full ring color on :focus-visible; inset variant inside scroll containers; translucent rings are banned.

rules.name: The Two Registers Rule
rules.body: Serif appears only in prose bodies the user reads and writes. Sans everywhere else. No exceptions.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every number that can be compared to a number above or below it is set in tabular figures, right-aligned.

rules.name: The Flat-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: A resting surface never casts a shadow. If an element is elevated, the user did something to lift it.

rules.name: The Compositor Rule
rules.body: If a motion can't be expressed in transform + opacity, it doesn't ship.

dos: Do keep the ground pure white and let pine + typography carry all character.
Do hold body text at >=4.5:1 contrast.
Do set every comparable number in tabular figures, right-aligned.
Do give every interactive element a visible focus state.
Do use density confidently in tables; calm comes from alignment and rhythm, not sparseness.
donts: Don't ship anything that reads as Salesforce/HubSpot CRM chrome.
Don't ship the generic SaaS template look — shadcn-default styling, gradient heroes, identical card grids, default purple accents.
Don't drift into the dark terminal aesthetic.
Don't use serif type in any UI control, label, table, or navigation.
Don't use color decoratively — no gradient text, no side-stripe borders, no glassmorphism.
Don't animate for decoration; nothing over 250ms.
Don't reach for a modal first.
